intent: Recover missed short controlled possessions and reduce false D without surrendering the existing development gains.
data: Same public labels only. Tracking inputs include padded context through 18934. No private labels, final-frame patches, new annotations or audit-window use.
initial_screen: Seed42, all three existing exclusion protocols; retain every scored method. Compare fixed faster team heads, milder dead-class weighting and observation-based emission/sequence rules.
postprocessing: Fast team evidence uses 11-frame smoothing; D retains 51-frame context. Test live-contact evidence when ball motion contradicts a D prediction. All transition rules are general, team symmetric and input-only.
confirmation: Freeze at most two finalists after screen, then run seeds42,43,44 across buffered_minutes, purged_spells and buffered_100_seconds. Compare paired seeds to the preserved current model, not merely the handoff model.
promotion: Require lower false-D count and higher mean recall over true live runs <=125 frames in buffered validation, no extra mostly missed stoppages, no material loss of total D recall (>0.02), and no stitched spellF1 loss across any confirmation protocol/seed. Report clipped-block regressions and uncertainty. If no candidate clears these checks, retain the current default.
warning: All checks reuse adaptively inspected labels and are development evidence, not independent/statistical or private-match proof. Short-run labels are diagnostic targets only and never inference features.
